name: feedback-coaching
description: Use for anonymized coaching, fair feedback, one-on-ones and team development.

# Feedback Coaching
Describe observable behavior and concrete examples, clarify impact, seek perspective, agree measurable expectations and supportive next steps. Avoid sensitive employee records or automated employee evaluation. Provide short conversation prompts and follow-up.

## Output
State observations, evidence, assumptions, prioritized actions, validation and human approval points. Do not claim actions or tests were completed unless tools actually ran.
